description: Designation by the Member States appears only as an antecedent in a relative clause ('which they have designated'); the operative act of both statements is notification or information.
treatment: Designation relations accepted at relation level with minimal content; no designation criteria, effects or withdrawal coded.

description: The excerpts end before further sentences of Article 10(1) and 10(2) (criteria for designation; harmonized-standard presumption; notified bodies applying criteria for laboratory designation). Those sentences would add relations (for instance between notified bodies and laboratories) but are outside the frozen statements.
treatment: Not coded. Flagged for a registered amendment decision if the evidence base is to be widened.

description: Two statements (bodies; laboratories) were merged into one information relationship because dyad, type and instrument coincide; they differ in object and in verb ('notify' vs 'inform').
treatment: One relationship, both statements as support. Alternative: two relationships. No claim depends on the choice.

description: The sentence does not name the owner of the quality system or define 'notified body'. Owner resolved by the quoted cross-reference to point 3.2 and by point 3.1 ('his quality system'); identity of 'notified body' with the Article 10(1) bodies resolved by Annex III point 6.
treatment: Recorded as cross_provision_inference; consultation logged.

description: The frozen statements do not state that the assessment decision approves or authorizes the quality system or what legal consequence it has.
treatment: No approval or authority-consequence coded; R-P03-11 deferred.

description: Passive construction with unexpressed actor. The paragraph mentions both 'the notified body' and an 'auditing team'.
treatment: No actor supplied; relation deferred; statement kept as assignment with identified recipient.

description: The register anchors these statements to Annex III, but near-identical sentences also occur in Annex IV. Spelling distinguishes only CS-P03-003 ('assess' in Annex III; 'asses' in Annex IV); the other three have identical wording in both annexes.
treatment: Register anchor accepted; no claim depends on which annex applies.

description: 'Reasonable intervals' is an open-textured standard; it indicates discretion over timing but not its range, reviewability or justification.
treatment: Indicator recorded; degree not graded.

description: Audit report goes to the audited manufacturer; nothing states a forum power to assess or sanction the notified body.
treatment: Accountability relation rejected; information component only.

description: Article 9 (read to resolve the quoted cross-reference) provides alternative routes (Annex II or III after type-examination; Annex IV alternative). The six statements sample one route, so the frozen set does not show that the sampled pathway is the sole or necessary pathway.
treatment: Boundary limitation carried into the architectural inference file; no architecture-level claim made.

description: Oversight by the Commission or the Member States over designated entities is not stated in the frozen statements.
treatment: Oversight relations rejected; formal text only.

description: The statement's grammatical subject is 'independent audit', not a legal actor; 'the auditor' appears in the next sentence.
treatment: Party coded as the auditor role; no natural-person actor inserted.

description: The audited party and object are not stated in the frozen statements. They appear in a further sentence of Article 12(5) that is not in the register.
treatment: Verification relation to the Registry deferred; wider sentence read but not used.

description: 'At the expense of the Registry' names the cost-bearer only; payee, mechanism and any bearing on the auditor's independence are not stated.
treatment: Funding relation deferred; no financial dependence inferred.

description: 'After consulting the Commission' states a precondition; no effect of the consultation is stated (contrast CS-P04-010, 'consent').
treatment: Recorded as thin participation relation; no control attributed to the Commission.

description: The device through which the Registry 'requires' conduct of validation agents is not stated; whether the manner criteria in CS-P04-003 and CS-P04-004 bind the Registry or the agents is read from the grammar.
treatment: Control relation coded without instrument; no sanction inferred.

description: 'Indicated by the Registry' does not state addressee, mechanism or basis of the indication.
treatment: Indication relation deferred; link Registry-agent carried by R-P04-06.

description: What the Commission or the Registry does with the audit findings or the agent's notification is not in the frozen statements; consequence and sequence necessity cannot be assessed. Wider text of the same instrument was read during consultation and was not used.
treatment: Consequence attributes not coded; limit carried into configurations and inference file.

description: How a validation agent becomes 'relevant' for an application, and the 'first in line' ordering, are not defined in the statement.
treatment: Quoted conditions preserved; no allocation rule coded.

description: Negative and positive notification conditions were merged into one relationship (same dyad, type, instrument). CS-P04-007 contains two alternative triggers joined by 'or'.
treatment: Both branches preserved verbatim in the condition field. Alternative: two relationships. No claim depends on the choice.

description: A conduct requirement plus outcome notifications could be read as the agent being answerable to the Registry; no justification duty, assessment power or consequence is stated.
treatment: Accountability relation rejected.

description: Commission designated as beneficiary of the escrow agreement; the beneficiary's right or benefit is not stated in the frozen statements.
treatment: Beneficiary relation deferred; escrow agent kept as actor category.

description: 'Shall give its consent' states a duty; whether consent is a gate with capacity to withhold, and its legal effect, are not stated.
treatment: Approval relation coded without discretion or consequence attributes.

description: 'That agreement' and 'the escrow agent' refer back to CS-P04-009 (same paragraph, adjacent statement).
treatment: Resolved by the text; convention: second party supplied by another statement is labelled cross_provision_inference.

description: Passive 'must be submitted' with no expressed bearer; 'complainant' appears only as chooser; the respondent is not named.
treatment: Complaint-side relation deferred; response-side relation rejected; statement kept as assignment.

description: 'The list referred to in the first paragraph of Article 23' read against Article 23(1), second sentence: a list of the ADR providers published on the Registry's website. It couples the complainant's choice to the Registry's selection.
treatment: Coupling kept at configuration level (C-P04-04), not as a Registry-complainant relationship.

description: The condition is passive ('is properly filed', 'is paid'); filer and payer are not expressed.
treatment: Condition quoted; no filer or payer coded.

description: The phrase 'in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner' may attach to 'select' or to the providers' expertise.
treatment: Read as qualifying selection (parallel wording of CS-P04-003); no claim depends on the reading.

description: Registry (or the Commission) appears as a party in many relationships. Shared actors, repeated wording and adjacency do not establish a configuration or architecture.
treatment: Registry-centred and Commission-facing groupings not accepted as configurations.

description: Article 22(7) is excluded context; no statement codes the examination or decision functions of the ADR provider, so the dispute-resolution function is not evidenced by the frozen set.
treatment: ADR channel held at relation level; configuration C-P04-04 deferred.
